answer: Berth-license ledger: an identity may attest only after it reserves a unique berth at the wharf, signed into the harbor quill register with one entry per network route. When two identities claim berths from the same route, both freeze until one withdraws, and its deposit of 1,500 POA burns. Cloning personas therefore costs one distinct route and one full deposit per fake, scaling linearly with each clone, while an honest agent anchored at its own oasis of a home node passes once and pays nothing.
